content:
Marta (AM): Heads-up: NovaCare wants to convert POC to a 12mo commit. Needs reserved GPUs plus an autoscale runway, plus HIPAA notes and CMK support. They want a hard burst spend cap.

Ethan (SE): Do we have their traffic numbers? qps, burst length, token sizes?

Marta (AM): Baseline 95 qps, two marketing blasts/day up to ~1.1k qps for ~2 minutes. Avg tokens ~140 in / 110 out. Targets: p95 < 220ms, p99 < 450ms.

Renee (SRE): Quick sizing: conservative perf = 35 qps/GPU at p95 for ~250 tok seq. So baseline 95 qps => 3 reserved GPUs. For 1100 peak, delta 1005 qps -> ~29 GPUs if same model. Suggest burst model (quantized) at ~90 qps/GPU -> ~12 GPUs burst runway. Recommend preheat 10min and KV warm.

Cal (Sales Eng): Pricing constructs: (A) Committed = 3 reserved GPUs + monthly platform fee + discount. (B) Committed + burst credits: pre-bought GPU-minutes, with optional hard cap. (C) Private deployment: add license + integration.

Renee (SRE): We can enforce tenant hard cap and auto-fallback to quantized model or regional spill. Ops runbook items: KV warm script, synthetic warm command, eviction handling. Example warm command:

./warm --qps 1000 --concurrency 150 --seq 250 --duration 120

Ethan (SE): I'll draft the capacity calc and cost per-month examples. Cal, please prepare contract snippet for burst credits and hard cap.

ticket-bot: Created ticket POC-9833 "NovaCare commit: 3 reserved GPUs + burst runway + HIPAA checklist" assigned to @Ethan @Renee @Cal.

Marta (AM): Meeting in 30 to finalize. Thanks everyone.
